startdate.title: Start Date
startdate.remarks: The date and time when the shift began. You can change this value when the status of the shift log is Draft.

reference.title: Shift Reference
reference.remarks: A reference for the shift log record. You can change this value unless the value of the shift log record is Inactive.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site associated with the shift log record. The combination of site and shift log must be unique. This value is the same as the site ID on the profile of the logged-in user. This field is read-only.

isshiftlog.title: Is Shift Log
isshiftlog.remarks: Identifies if the field is a shift log or not. If the flag is marked, the record is a shift log; otherwise it is a run log

period.title: Period
period.remarks: The period of this shift log record.  Valid values are in the PLUSGSHIFTPERIOD domain. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.

logbooknum.title: Log Book
logbooknum.remarks: The identifier of the log book.

route.title: Asset List
route.remarks: The asset list that is associated with the shift log. If you perform an advanced search on this field, the application returns all shift logs that include this asset list.

orgshiftnum.title: Original Shift Log
orgshiftnum.remarks: The identifier of the shift log whose log entries you want to carry over to the next shift.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.remarks: The supervisor of the shift. The status of the corresponding Person record must be Active. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the shift log record. Valid values are in the PLUSGSHFTLOGSTATUS synonym domain. The default status, when you create a record, is Draft. You can change this value only by using the Change Status action.

productline.title: Product Line
productline.remarks: The product line that is associated with the run log.

validatedrun.title: Validated Run
validatedrun.remarks: Specifies whether the run data is validated. If the check box is selected, the run data is validated.

tubularassy.title: Tubular Assembly
tubularassy.remarks: The tubular assembly that is associated with the run.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of the shift log. You can change this value if the status of the shift log record is Draft or Active.

haslogentries.title: Log Entries
haslogentries.remarks: Indicates whether the log contains log entries.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: The asset that is associated with the shift log. If you perform an advanced search on this field, the application returns all shift logs that include this asset. The location that is associated with the asset is copied to the Location field.

comments.title: Shift Comments
comments.remarks: Comments about the shift log. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.

classstructureid.title: Classification
classstructureid.remarks: A classification of the shift log.

controlroom.title: Control Room
controlroom.remarks: The control room of the shift log. Valid values are in the PLUSGCONTROLROOM domain. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.

finishdate.title: Finish Date
finishdate.remarks: The date and time when the shift finished. You can change this value when the status of the shift log is Draft.

shiftnum.title: Shift Log
shiftnum.remarks: The identifier of the shift log record. The combination of site and shift log must be unique. After you create and save the shift log record, this field is read-only.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the shift log record was created or its status was changed through the Change Status action. This field is read-only.

wonum.title: Work Order
wonum.remarks: The work order that is associated with the shift log. If you perform an advanced search on this field, the application returns all shift logs that include this work order.

plantmode.title: Plant Mode
plantmode.remarks: The plant mode of the shift log record. Valid values are in the PLUSGPLANTMODE domain. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the shift log.

kpiname.title: KPI
kpiname.remarks: The key performance indicator that is used to track the implementation of the run log. You can change this value when the status of the run log record is Active or Draft.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the shift log. Valid values are in the PLUSGSHIFTCATEGORY domain. You can change this value unless the status of the shift log record is Inactive.
